state.question: These numbered clips are shuffled segments from one cooking video. Determine their chronological order. Return only clip numbers joined by ->.
state.summary: No visual calls remain, so I project the best evidence-supported chronology. v5 shows peanut grinding, which must precede v4's peanut addition and is placed as prep before cooking. v2 establishes an oil/tofu/aromatics base before noodles. v3 shows oil being added to noodles. v1 shows a later liquid addition to noodles already combined with ingredients and stirred. v4 shows the most complete pan state with noodles, bean sprouts, egg, and peanuts being added.
